name: Ankle wallet
description: A flat zipped pouch on an elastic band, worn round the ankle under a trouser leg to keep cash and papers out of sight.
notes: Laid flat: a black nylon pouch 120 mm by 90 mm on a charcoal band 300 mm long with a grey hook-and-loop patch at one end. Takes the ankle slot as the ankle magazine pouch does. Its slow handling time stands for reaching under a trouser leg. Choosing a side has no content field yet. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Armband pouch
description: A small flapped canvas pouch on a buckled strap that wraps round the upper arm, made for runners and hikers.
notes: Laid flat: a canvas pouch 120 mm by 90 mm with a flap on a black webbing strap 400 mm long with a side-release buckle. Takes the arms slot that arm guards use; an upper-arm slot would let it sit under a guard, but none exists. Choosing a side has no content field yet. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Daypack
description: A small nylon backpack with a rounded top and a zipped front pocket, big enough for a day's water and food.
notes: Standing, front pocket toward the iso view, a navy body with black straps, back pad and zip. The model stands at its real size. The denim and leather backpacks share this model with their own finishes. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Denim backpack
description: A small backpack sewn from denim, with tan leather straps and a zipped front pocket.
notes: Shares the daypack's model in denim with a faded front pocket, tan leather straps and brass fittings. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Leather backpack
description: A small brown leather backpack with black straps and a zipped front pocket; heavier than nylon and longer-lasting.
notes: Shares the daypack's model in brown leather with a red-brown pocket, black straps and brass fittings. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Giant novelty backpack
description: A gag backpack blown up to nearly a person's height. It is ridiculous to wear and drags at the backs of the knees, but it holds a great deal.
notes: The daypack's shape at 750 mm wide and 1.15 m tall in yellow with red pockets, blue straps and an oversized zip pull. The back slot alone stands for the whole load. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Hunting pack
description: A large brown hunting pack with a lid, side pockets, a hip belt and straps under the base for a bedroll or a game bag.
notes: Standing, front toward the iso view: a coyote body with a brown lid, front and side pockets, black compression straps and two lashing straps hanging at the base. Points: left side straps and right side straps are the compression straps on each side; base straps are the two straps at the foot of the front. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Large tactical backpack
description: A squared olive pack with a padded hip belt and rows of webbing across its front pocket for extra pouches.
notes: Standing, front toward the iso view: an olive drab body with four rows of dark webbing on the front pocket, side compression straps and a hip belt. Drawn in nylon, as packs of this kind are made. Points: front webbing is the four rows on the front pocket; left side and right side are the compression straps. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: High-volume rucksack
description: A tall leather rucksack with a deep lid, side pockets and three rows of compression straps. It carries almost anything, and a full one hurts the back.
notes: Standing, front toward the iso view: brown leather with a red-brown lid and pockets, black straps and brass buckles. Points: left side straps and right side straps are the compression straps on each side; lid straps are the two straps holding the lid down the front. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Pack frame
description: A heavy L-shaped timber frame with a shelf at the foot and leather straps, for carrying one large, awkward load on the back.
notes: Standing, shelf toward the iso view: pine uprights, three rails and a braced shelf, two leather load straps with iron buckles across the face and leather shoulder straps behind. Points: the upper and lower load straps across the frame's face. The load grid stands for whatever is strapped to the shelf. The box is the bare frame. A crafted item; it keeps a low loot tier. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Trapper's frame pack
description: Waxed canvas stretched over a pole frame and gathered shut at the top with a drawstring, carried on canvas shoulder straps.
notes: Standing, front toward the iso view: grey canvas over a frame whose four oak corner posts and foot rails stand proud, the top drawn in to a corded neck with a toggle, canvas shoulder straps behind. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Bindle
description: A cloth tied into a bundle on the end of a stick, carried over the shoulder. It leaves a hand busy.
notes: Lying on the ground: a red cotton bundle tied at the top with its corners as ears, on an oak stick 1 m long whose far end rests on the floor; held by the stick. It is carried in the hand, so it has no wearable slot. The box counts the stick.

name: Book strap
description: Two crossed leather straps under a stiff carrying handle, buckled round a stack of books to carry them.
notes: Laid flat and empty: two tan straps buckled into crossed loops with brass buckles under a brown handle. It hangs from the hand, so it has no wearable slot. The box counts the open loops. The grid is sized for a stack of books.

name: Box backpack
description: A lidded wooden box with two rope loops tied to its back for shoulder straps. Stiff, heavy and crude, but it keeps its shape.
notes: Standing, lid up and hasp toward the iso view: pine sides with oak corner battens, iron hinges and hasp, and two jute rope loops on the back. A crafted item; it keeps a low loot tier. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Briefcase
description: A hard plastic case with a carrying handle and two latches, made for papers and anything else that should stay flat and dry.
notes: Standing on its long edge, latches toward the iso view: charcoal shells meeting at a grey seam, a black handle and silver latches; held by the handle. It is carried in the hand, so it has no wearable slot.
